text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Here it is! A once-in-a-lifetime hand! A
Royal
Straight Flush!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what to do... but I guess I'll
raise...
What about you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I've got nothing again, so I'll fold...

Actually, I think I'm gonna go home.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Don't be a quitter. You're wasting

everyone's time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa loses her enthusiasm
because of
the lame ending to her game.
